title: Decision: an undecodable leaf app_components list counts as empty for the -11 §5 own-listing check
description: mls-extensions-11 §5 (own-listing rule, PR #113) doesn't say what happens when a LeafNode's own app_components entry does not decode as a ComponentsList. Readings: (a) treat it as empty, so any other dictionary entry makes the leaf invalid; (b) refuse the leaf outright with a separate malformed-list error. Chosen: (a), matching how first_unsupported already reads untrusted leaf lists; it fails closed whenever the leaf carries any other entry. member.rs first_unlisted_entry. GREASE entries get no exemption (§5.2 requires them listed).
close_reason: Chosen by orchestrator per worker's reading; fails closed; flag to Mark
